verdict.rationale: RevenueCat offers webhooks and scheduled data exports that run on a schedule/trigger without manual intervention, which is a weak form of background automation, and an MCP server/AI Toolkit lets AI agents interact with the platform, though only on-demand rather than autonomously scheduled. Missing for 10: no evidence of a rules/workflow engine for user-defined autonomous automations, no evidence of persistent background agent tasks, no independent confirmation these run reliably unattended.
